description: x402 integration test for agents and payment clients: after a real USDC payment it confirms the payment arrived and echoes back what the server saw: network (Base or Arc), scheme, payer address, amount, asset and recipient, plus server time and an optional echo string. Useful for checking that a wallet, x402 client and budget limits work end to end before calling costlier services, and for uptime monitoring. The cheapest paid call VerifyLite offers. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

echo.description: Optional text to echo back (up to 256 characters).
